messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: horseshoe and horseshoe+
parts:
[moved to stan-dev]

> On Tue, Feb 17, 2015 at 10:20 AM, Andrew Gelman <gel...@stat.columbia.edu> wrote:
...
> In implementing stan_lm and stan_glm, maybe we should have the horseshoe and horseshoe+ priors as precoded options:

> http://andrewgelman.com/2015/02/17/bayesian-survival-analysis-horseshoe-priors/

> That way the user can just use these prior routinely. This could give a bit boost to Stan for the sort of many-predictors “machine learning” regression problems where people are now running lasso.
...

These requests need to go in the issue tracker with
priorities (next release, 3.0, or future), ideally with
definitions or at least pointers to literature with definitions.

I went ahead and created the feature request with a link
to the blog post, which in turn links to Aki's implementation:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1303

I gave them a vague priority of "future". We can boost
that if somebody actually needs them some time soon.

I'd guess a couple days work for somebody to code and test
and doc it a couple new related densities.

If there's an example that should go in
the manual or in example-models, please add as a comment
to the issue.

- Bob
